summary: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF (TDOG, Nasdaq; Maryland statutory trust) filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026 reporting under Item 1.02 that on November 5, 2026 the sponsor, 21Shares US LLC, gave immediate notice of termination of the Support Services Agreement with House of Doge Inc., covering research, data, operational support and marketing services to the Trust; 21Shares AG is also a party. No financial terms, fee, wind-down or replacement-provider details were disclosed, and no board recommendation or advisor is named. The action is a routine service-contract termination for a commodity-type crypto fund; no special-situation transaction is implicated. Watch for disclosure of successor service arrangements and any effect on the Trust's operations or marketing.
